# Format
```{r responders vs nonresponders}
recist_pts <- recist %>%
  mutate(pts = ifelse(recist$Category == "PR" | recist$Category == "CR", 
                          "responder", "nonresponder")) %>%
                          select(`Patient.ID`, Cohort, Category, 
                                 pts) %>% drop_na(`Patient.ID`)
                       

                      
                          
pfs_pts <- pfsnonres %>% 
  mutate(pts = ifelse(`12-month PFS` == "Yes", "responder", 
                          "nonresponder")) %>% select(`Patient.ID`, `12-month PFS`, pts) %>% drop_na(`12-month PFS`)

responsepts_mut <- left_join(recist_pts,pfs_pts, by = "Patient.ID") %>% 
                    select(Patient.ID, Cohort, Category, pts.x, pts.y)

write.csv(resnoninfo, "mitox_resnoncombine.csv", row.names = FALSE)

                                   select(Patient.ID, Cohort, Category, Response)
```

```{r irae}
irae <- iraetab %>% select(Patient.ID, Symptoms, `Attribution (Final)`, `CTCAE grade (final)`) %>%
                    filter(grepl("Yes",`Attribution (Final)` ))  %>% 
        mutate(`Patient Id` = Patient.ID, irAE = ifelse( `Attribution (Final)` == "Yes", "irAE", "no irAE"))

        mutate(`Patient Id` = Patient.ID, irAE = ifelse( `Attribution (Final)` == "Yes", "irAE", "no irAE"))
```

```{r}

#manually edited tabone file
table1(data=tabone, ~ Age + Sex + Race + irAE + Cohort + Treatment |Response)



labels <- list(
    variables=list(Sex="Sex",
                   Age="Age (years)",
                   Race="Race",
                   irAE="irAE",
                   Patient.Type= "Patient Type",
                   Treatment= "Treatment"),
    groups=list("","Response"))


strata <- c(list(Total=tabone), split(tabone, tabone$Response))


table1(strata, labels, groupspan=c( 1, 2))


```

```{r}

#manually edited tabone_met file
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  x <- x[-length(x)]
    y <- unlist(x)
    g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
    if (is.numeric(y)) {
      
        p <- t.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    } else {
       
        p <- fisher.test(table(y, g))$p.value
    }
    
    c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}
```
